mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing the present value of equities and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is above 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (both key demand indicators) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their previous month's level, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO rising above 102.5), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO is rising above 102.5, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1300, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS rising) indicates a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102.0 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 102.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in nonfarm payrolls below 155000 signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS is below 155000, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
